description: Land Acquisition - Interim Plan No. 125 and No. 43 of Dambadeniya, Mahaoya D/S Division, Ampara District - Kirinda, Puhulwella D/S Division, Matarta District - Thalawathugoda, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices for acquiring specific parcels of land for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land lots, boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
